visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a young Asian man wearing a black sweatshirt and black trousers, standing inside a large red structural box that mimics a toy packaging case with the TinyTAN logo. He performs a brief muscular pose. The setting is a brightly lit indoor studio with a white wall and a wooden bookshelf visible to the left. (2) A transition featuring a crumpled paper texture cuts to the man now wearing a white denim jacket over a red shirt. He holds two small red branded boxes while standing in the same red structure, looking directly into the camera with an excited smile. (3) A hand from a POV perspective enters the frame and points toward the boxes. The man brings the boxes closer to the lens, showing the red packaging and white logos clearly. The background remains consistent with the studio and the red box structure. (4) The man opens a box and reveals a miniature figurine with light blue hair, a headband, and a white suit. He holds it close to the camera, gesturing with his other hand. White variety-show style text appears at the bottom of the frame. (5) The camera cuts to a close-up of a second figurine wearing a black bucket hat and black clothing, resting on a white wrinkled fabric. The man then appears back in the red box, holding both figurines and smiling broadly. (6) A final sequence shows several figurines together on a table, followed by the man holding a figurine and the packaging box, pointing to text on the screen that details a promotional price and a McDonald's logo.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, high-tempo pop music starts immediately with an electronic synth melody. A male narrator begins speaking in an extremely excited, high-pitched tone in Traditional Chinese. A short 'pop' sound effect is heard as a visual cut occurs. (2) A crinkling paper sound effect marks a transition. The narrator continues at a fast speech rate, describing the toy boxes. The BGM maintains a consistent, driving electronic beat. (3) A 'whoosh' sound transition occurs as the POV hand appears. The narrator's voice rises in excitement. Subtle plastic rustling is audible as he moves the small boxes. (4) A loud 'pop' sound effect coincides with the reveal of the first figurine. The narrator shouts the character's name 'SUGA' with high arousal. The BGM remains energetic in the background. (5) Another transition sound effect leads into the second reveal. The narrator's speech becomes denser as he details the figurine's features. The BGM synth loop is bright and sharp. (6) A light 'ding' sound effect highlights the text about the promotional price. The narrator's tone shifts to a professional but still energetic call to action. The music maintains its volume until a sharp fade-out at the end.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Transition -> Product Reveal -> Close-up Details -> Promo Info -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional unboxing and review of the McDonald's x TinyTAN (BTS) blind box collection. It uses high-energy editing, excited narration, and close-up product shots to build hype and inform viewers about the limited-time offer and pricing.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video explicitly shows the McDonald's logo, details the pricing for the 'TinyTAN' blind boxes, and encourages viewers to purchase the 'Extra Value Meal' to get the toy.
